# Diagram types and ground rules

Every type has conventions the AI follows and the linter checks. The full rules for a type are also served by the MCP tool `get_diagram_rules(type)` and by `visio-ai rules TYPE`.

| Type | Use when | Rules |
|---|---|---|
| `flowchart` | you need the steps and decisions of one process, with a clear start and end. | [rules](rules/flowchart.md) |
| `architecture` | you need the software components of a system and how they call each other, independent of where they run. | [rules](rules/architecture.md) |
| `cloud` | you need to show which Azure, AWS or Google Cloud services implement a system and how they are scoped and connected. | [rules](rules/cloud.md) |
| `c4-context` | you need the big picture for any audience: your system as one box, the people who use it and the systems it depends on. | [rules](rules/c4-context.md) |
| `c4-container` | you need the deployable apps, services and data stores inside one system, with their technologies and how they communicate. | [rules](rules/c4-container.md) |
| `deployment` | you need to show what runs where: environments, hosts, clusters and the networks between them. | [rules](rules/deployment.md) |
| `network` | you need the physical or virtual network: sites, segments, subnets, routing, firewalls and the devices on them. | [rules](rules/network.md) |
| `dataflow` | you need to show where data comes from, how it is transformed and where it ends up (lineage, integration, privacy reviews). | [rules](rules/dataflow.md) |
| `pipeline` | you need the ordered stages of a build/release or data pipeline, with gates and artifacts. | [rules](rules/pipeline.md) |
| `erd` | you need the entities (tables) of a data model and the relationships and cardinalities between them. | [rules](rules/erd.md) |
| `org` | you need reporting lines: who reports to whom in a team, department or company. | [rules](rules/org.md) |
| `swimlane` | a process crosses people, teams or systems and the hand-offs between them matter. | [rules](rules/swimlane.md) |
| `state` | one object (order, ticket, device, session) moves through states driven by events. | [rules](rules/state.md) |
| `mindmap` | you need to break one central topic into themes and ideas (brainstorms, capability maps, scoping). | [rules](rules/mindmap.md) |

General rules for every diagram: [rules/general.md](rules/general.md). Cloud providers: [Azure](rules/cloud-azure.md), [AWS](rules/cloud-aws.md), [Google Cloud](rules/cloud-gcp.md).
